content.short: OverHyped is an NFT marketplace and protocol that enables users to create tech-enabled apparel with their artwork and NFT assets.
content.description: OverHyped is an NFT marketplace and protocol that allows creators to design tech-enabled apparel using their own artwork and NFT assets. The OverHyped Panda NFT series, a collection of more than 5,000 hand-drawn pandas, is featured on apparel and accessories. These items provide verifiable authenticity through NFC technology. By merging digital tokens with physical wearables, OverHyped creates a tangible link between art, ownership, and everyday fashion.
